761270102.text: (Right, there was an accident on board the spaceship... We got into the escape pods... Did we make moonfall successfully?)

761270103.text: (It seems like I'm still in my escape pod... I need to make sure Paimon's alright...)

subQuests.subQuestName: Find a way to return to the surface

761270201.text: Ohhh, Paimon just knew you'd be okay!

761270203.text: Not good at all! When Paimon came out of her escape pod, you two were gone... Paimon was scared half to death!

761270204.text: It's all good now that she's found you, though! Hehe.

761270205.text: Now then, let Paimon give you a quick once-over! Are you hurt or anything?

761270207.text: Well, that's a relief! Who could have imagined that ancient ship would run into problems... Wait, no, we totally should've seen this coming...

761270208.text: It was buried underground for who knows how many years, after all. It's a miracle that bucket of bolts could even fly!

761270209.text: Whew... Whatever. The ride was kinda awful... but we still made moonfall in the end...

761270211.text: Paimon blames Eggie for distracting us! We totally neglected to give the spaceship a good looking over.

761270212.text: Speaking of Eggie... Where is she? Paimon remembers she got into an escape pod, too.

761270401.text: Success! Well, that was easier than Paimon expected.

761270402.text: But we still need to activate the third station, right?

761270404.text: Whoa, you're right... It still works, after all this time? Dragon tech sure is reliable...

761270405.text: Someone else might have activated it...

761270406.text: Someone else? You mean... Columbina? After all, who else could it be... But why did she only activate one?

761270407.text: You don't think... she found out something was wrong? Are we gonna run into some sort of problem?

761270408.text: Hey... Eggie, you're not misleading us again, are you? This one's coming out of your friendship level!

761270409.text: I don't know... what my mission is...

761270410.text: But I'm sure it doesn't include... raising anyone's friendship levels...

761270411.text: Huh!? Eggie, you've changed! Did all that info from the terminals go to your head?

761270412.text: Let's check out the Eye of Ibni-Belum first, shall we?

761270413.text: #Hmm... {NICKNAME}... more rational... reliable... good thinker... a superior partner... unlike Paimon...

761270415.text: Huh!? Okay, that's it! Paimon's deducting another ten percent from your share of the snacks!

761270501.text: Look! There's an escape pod! This must be Eggie's one, right?

761270502.text: But she doesn't seem to be in there... She must've made it out safely.

761270503.text: Could she have escaped into this ruin-like place...? We should go inside and look for her.

subQuests.subQuestName: Look for Eggie within the ruins
Look for Eggie within the ruins
Look for Eggie within the ruins
Look for Eggie within the ruins
Look for Eggie within the ruins
Look for Eggie within the ruins

761270601.text: Eggie! We're here to rescue you!

761270603.text: Hey! Eggie, wake up! It's us!

761270605.text: Snap out of it! We're here to rescue you! You're safe now!

761270606.text: Oh...! Oh... I'm sorry... It's you...

761270607.text: How did you get captured by those things? Do you know what this place is?

761270611.text: ...It's at the entrance... It has... information...

761270612.text: Oh! Is that the thingamajig we saw on our way in? Let's go find it.

761270301.text: Is this the terminal you were talking about, Eggie?

761270308.text: So the terminal's got your name in it? And you're called Ninnin?

761270309.text: The moons' power... can record... information...

761270310.text: It is... stored in the terminal...

761270311.text: Ah! So you can read the information in the terminal? Then, you know what this place is?

761270312.text: It's an energy generation station... used to produce... and store energy...

761270313.text: So those glowing orbs from earlier must have been some sorta energy, right?

761270314.text: You must've been taken away to be used as an energy source because you have the same power...

761270315.text: What is this energy generation station used for?

761270316.text: To power... the Eye of Ibni-Belum...

761270317.text: The Eye... of Ibni-Belum? What's that? Sounds kinda familiar.

761270318.text: It was one of the spaceship landing sites.

761270319.text: The... Eye of Ibni-Belum? What's that supposed to be?

761270320.text: Here are the engineering blueprints... let me show you...

761270321.text: The tall tower in the middle... That is the Eye...

761270322.text: Whoa, that's so cool! What about the three shorter towers? Are they energy generators?

761270323.text: Yes... We're inside one of them right now...

761270324.text: What exactly does this Eye of Ibni-Belum do?

761270325.text: The work logs record that... it is a lunar surface monitoring station... capable of monitoring the entire lunar surface.

761270326.text: Monitor the lunar surface? That's amazing!

761270327.text: Then... doesn't that mean it could help us search for Columbina's whereabouts?

761270328.text: I don't know... but... It's possible...

761270329.text: Looks like we're taking a trip over there then.

761270331.text: So that means we still have to deal with the other two, right? No problem! We've done this kind of thing tons of times.

761270336.text: Alright, alright, so you're Ninnin, aka Eggie. Does that work?

761270338.text: Hey! Meet Paimon in the middle here, would ya!?

761270339.text: Don't forget you got us stranded in this wasteland where there's not a single restaurant in sight... Do you still want your snacks or not!?

761270342.text: Sorry, what was that about snacks?

761270343.text: Oh, uh, that's between Paimon and Ninnin!

761270344.text: C'mon! We need to head to the other stations!

subQuests.subQuestName: Search for other energy generation stations

761272101.text: This terminal's been left out here all by itself... Poor thing.

761272102.text: Is it the energy generation station's terminal? Why don't you give it a try, Eggie?

761272104.text: How's it looking? Any new intel?

761272105.text: This is the energy generation station terminal... but... I retrieved no new information...

761272106.text: Hmm... Even though we didn't find any new intel, we still managed to activate station number two. Paimon would say that's a job well done!

761272107.text: Wait... Signal locator malfunction detected... Energy cannot be transmitted to the Eye of Ibni-Belum.

761272108.text: Huh? What are we going to do?

761272109.text: The signal locator... is at the top of the tower... It requires manual adjustment...

761272110.text: Huh... Then let's figure out a way to get up there and check it out.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the top to adjust the signal locator
Head for The Eye of Ibni-Belum

761272601.text: So this is the Eye of Ibni-Belum? It definitely feels like a special place...

761272603.text: I think... I'll get some useful information.

761272604.text: Hmph, let's hope it doesn't puff your head up even more.

761272606.text: I activated... the Eye of Ibni-Belum...

761272607.text: Oh? Did it work? Can you find Columbina?

761272608.text: Hmm... in the facility known as Ungien's Circle... the terminal has detected...

761272609.text: ...The appearance of an unknown individual lacking an identification code...

761272611.text: The system cannot confirm this person's identity...

761272612.text: Looks like we have to check it out in person.

761272613.text: Hmm... We can't be totally sure, but at least we have a lead for now... So, how are we gonna get there?

761272614.text: Let me help... Look... we can use this to get across...

761272616.text: It's the entrance to the high-speed transit lane... it runs on the ancient moons' power...

761272617.text: Through it... you can reach the next stop from the Eye of Ibni-Belum... Ungien's Circle...

761272618.text: The terminal records state that... many species of creatures live there... it is a home for living beings...

761272619.text: So, there are all kinds of creatures living on the moon? That's incredible...

761272621.text: Please wait a moment... Something in the terminal is still responding to me...

761272624.text: There is a hidden module... "Project Moongazer"... It responded to me...

761272626.text: The module... records the origins of this tower...

761272627.text: It starts with a dragon pioneer named Ibni{RUBY#[S]the first Moongazer}-Belum...

761272628.text: The lunar vessel we traveled in... was his creation... He was the one who led dragon researchers to the moon...

761272629.text: W—Wow, that's amazing! So this place must've been built to commemorate him, right?

761272630.text: Not exactly... The terminal recorded this instead...

761272631.text: After the pioneer landed... he began to explore the moon and circumlunar zone...

761272632.text: Then, one day... while in the circumlunar zone, he received a... mysterious signal from deep space...

761272633.text: A signal from deep space? What was it?

761272634.text: The researchers couldn't decipher the signal's meaning...

761272635.text: But the pioneer believed... it was a message sent back... by their king who had journeyed out into the sea of stars...

761272636.text: And that king's name... was Nibelung.

761272637.text: Th—The Dragon King!? Did the signal really come from him?

761272638.text: I don't know... because the researchers could not enter deep space...

761272640.text: This place, the Eye... It was originally a deep-space signal transceiver station... built to recapture that signal...

761272642.text: Many years went by... the pioneer passed away... but the signal never appeared again...

761272643.text: His students gave up years later... and turned to more practical pursuits.

761272644.text: They renovated the Eye into a lunar surface monitoring station... to make it easier for them to conduct more practical lunar research...

761272645.text: Aww, what a shame... Wow, Paimon feels like we just stumbled on something super important...

761272647.text: No... these are just the log entries I read...

761272648.text: The real project file is encrypted... I can't open it...

761272649.text: Huh? Didn't you say it responded to you? Shouldn't you be able to, y'know, open it?

761272650.text: My data matches it... but maybe because... it isn't enough...

761272651.text: Err, sorry, what do you mean by "isn't enough"!?

761272652.text: It's like how... snacks and Paimon are a match... but twenty percent of the snacks won't be enough for Paimon to eat.

761272653.text: Hey, you're the one who gets twenty percent. Paimon's getting eighty!

761272654.text: Sounds like Eggie is a key mold of sorts.

761272655.text: Some content is missing, so a key can't be forged.

761272656.text: Hmm... Yeah, Paimon feels like that's exactly it! Come to think of it, could this "Project Moongazer" be connected to Eggie's mission?

761272657.text: It responded to Eggie's message. In fact, it feels almost like it was waiting for her to show up!

761272658.text: I don't know... but I want to... open it...

761272660.text: If there's not enough information, then we just need to go find more terminals, right?

761272661.text: Paimon noticed that with every terminal Eggie absorbs, she speaks a little more smoothly — and gets a little more full of herself.

761272662.text: While Paimon could certainly do without the attitude, if this is Eggie's mission, then Paimon's gonna help!

761272665.text: Heh! Well, Eggie did help us look for Columbina, didn't she?

761272666.text: Don't worry, Eggie! Since there's a terminal here, there's gotta be more up ahead! Come with us, and we'll make sure you get plenty to eat.

761272667.text: Thank you... Paimon... I'll try my best... not to puff up...

761272668.text: Hehehe. So, should we head to the next stop now?

761272670.text: Yay! Second stop on our super awesome lunar adventure — the "Ungi-Ungi Circle"! Let's go!
